caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile pattern centrally positioned on a light beige background. The textile pattern, rendered in black and white, consists of intricate geometric and symmetrical designs. The pattern includes repeating rectangles, squares, and bands, with a central area forming a starburst or radiating petal effect composed of lines that extend outward. Surrounding the central motif, there are various smaller, detailed checkerboard and grid patterns, as well as larger rectangular elements with horizontal bands. The design is densely filled, leaving very little negative space within the patterned area, and the dark color contrasts sharply with the lighter sections, highlighting the detailed geometric shapes. The textile is bordered by a subtle edge and is set off from the surrounding plain, unadorned paper, on which faint brownish marks are visible mostly at the top edge. A small inscription, possibly the creator’s signature, is lightly visible near the lower right corner of the textile sample.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
